description: Full of vigor and larger than life, this young beast and his outlandish mannerisms stand out like a sore thumb in a land of sullen snow and ice. Ni'en, as he called himself, belonged to a race of fantastically strange creatures known as Sanje from beyond the sea. Sporting golden manes flowing over a body encased in emerald scales, fiery eyes, and ruby-red antlers above the brow, their brutish appearances led many to label them misshapen monstrosities.None of that discouraged Ni'en from seeking out company, however. Inherent to intelligent creatures were "spirits", the pure energies of life. Good spirits kept a Sanje happy, while they would devour the impure ones. Though Ni'en invoked transformative magics to conceal his beastly appearance, part of his face and one arm escaped unchanged. Far from being bothered, Ni'en figured it was pretty "cool", as he heard human youth describing the concept to each other. And if started conversations, so much the better!Unfortunately, after getting run out of every village, Ni'en started to feel disheartened. Why were humans so difficult to understand?As he wandered farther into the wilds, something in the distance piqued his senses, along with the familiar scent of scorched earth. Kin? In these forsaken lands? But beneath the burns smoldered something strange, something dark...and Ni'en had a mind to follow his intuition. Cracking his knuckles (gently, with his human hand!), the spirited youth huffed out a breath and followed in their wake.For however grotesque Ni'en may seem, none knew better than he when there was evil to be devoured.
